from: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Ask and remember' also asks before file reads, and can remember a file or folder. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.
to: 工具调用的默认批准行为。'Always ask' 仅自动批准只读工具。'Ask and remember' 还会在读取文件前询问，并可记住文件或文件夹。'Write' 自动批准读取和工作区写入工具。'Yolo' 自动批准所有层级；用户策略仍可能提示或阻止/Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Ask and remember' also asks before file reads, and can remember a file or folder. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.
